metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix rib pain for good AT HOME! 

In this video, two parts are shown that will QUICKLY help relieve rib pain. The first part will focus on the ribs of the upper back (between the shoulder blades) and tight, achy muscle knots and spasms. The second part will focus on pain over the sternum (chest bone), front ribs, and costochondritis. 

All of these rib pain relief exercises are EASY and EFFECTIVE, and may give fast relief in as little as 30 seconds! As a bonus, no special equipment is needed and all of these can be done at home.

Watch now and get rid of rib pain for good!
